agency.name: Utah State Tax Commission, Division of Motor Vehicles

gaps: Registration fees are indexed every January 1: the amounts are the 2026 adjusted fees published by the Legislature's research office; renewals in 2027 and later will be slightly higher, and the 2027 electric car fee is not published yet.

On a dealer sale the sales tax rate is the one of the dealer's location; on a private sale it is the rate where the car is registered. The list holds every county's unincorporated rate and the main cities (Tax Commission chart of July 1, 2026, resort tax excluded); type your rate for any other city.
Emissions inspection prices are set by the stations and were not published on a page that could be read, so the line has no amount.
The DMV license plate fee for new plates is set by the division's fee schedule and could not be read (dmv.utah.gov and tax.utah.gov refused connections during this check); it is not included.
The $6 title fee, the corridor preservation counties and the air pollution control fees come from DMV pages last archived in 2025.

summary.docFeeNote: No cap was found in Utah law; the document fee is a charge for a service needed to complete the sale and is taxed with the car.
summary.inspectionWhere: Emissions inspection in Salt Lake, Davis, Utah, Weber and Cache counties, every two years until the car is six and every year after; cars less than two years old and electric cars are exempt.

singular: Utah taxes a car at the combined sales tax rate of the place of sale, from 6.35% in several rural counties to 7.95% in Park City, and the resort community tax does not apply to vehicles [rates].
A trade-in is subtracted from the taxable price, but in a private sale only another vehicle counts as a trade-in [trade-in].
The dealer's charge for any service needed to complete the sale is part of the taxable price [doc-taxable].
The statute still says $44, but the 2026 registration fee for a passenger car after inflation indexing is $58.25, plus an indexed $7.50 add-on created in 2023 [briefing].
Instead of a property tax, every car pays a uniform age-based fee each year: $150 under 3 years, then $110, $80, $50 and $10 from 12 years on [uniform].
An electric car pays a $180 flat fee in 2026, or can join the Road Usage Charge program at 1.25 cents a mile up to that amount [ruc].
Hybrids pay an extra $25 and plug-in hybrids $64 a year after the 2026 indexing [briefing].
Eleven counties, including Salt Lake, Utah and Davis, add a $10 corridor preservation fee to each registration [dmv-fees].
Cars in Salt Lake, Davis, Utah, Weber and Cache counties need an emissions test, every two years while under six years old [emissions].
A new Utah title costs $6, the same as a duplicate [dmv-summary].

uniform.name: Utah Code § 59-2-405.1, uniform age-based fee
uniform.quote: the uniform fee for purposes of this section is as follows: Age of Vehicle | Uniform Fee | 12 or more years | $10 | 9 or more years but less than 12 years | $50 | 6 or more years but less than 9 years | $80 | 3 or more years but less than 6 years | $110 | Less than 3 years | $150

ruc.name: Utah Department of Transportation, Road Usage Charge program
ruc.quote: The flat fee applicable to each 12-month vehicle registration period beginning in 2026 is $180. ... 1.25 cents per mile (the 2026 calendar year mileage rate) will be deducted from your prepaid wallet, up to the amount of the flat fee.
